record.deltaSub: Auth audit log retention, Free plan
record.headline: Supabase extended Auth Audit Logs retention on the Free plan from 1 hour to 24 hours.
record.who: Projects on the Free plan; paid plans (7 days and 28 days) are unchanged.
record.read: A longer free retention window makes audit logs more usable for debugging and evaluation without upgrading, while the paid tiers keep a clear gap at 7 days and 28 days.
record.caveat: No announcement was checked; it is not clear whether existing projects are affected immediately.
